name: session-handoff
description: Hand work off to another Claude session: pick the receiving session, review a short six-part brief (goal, done, decisions, files, next step, acceptance criterion), then send it. Secrets redacted, duplicates and auto-reply loops blocked.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane and of the handoff message: ar (Arabic) or en (English).

replyGuard.title: Auto-reply guard
replyGuard.description: Right after a handoff arrives (or a reply to one you sent), the main conversation's model may not send messages for a short while, so two sessions cannot answer each other in a loop.

replyCooldownSeconds.title: Auto-reply guard, seconds
replyCooldownSeconds.description: How long the auto-reply guard stands after a handoff, beyond the turn that reads it.

maxHandoffsPerHour.title: Handoffs per hour
maxHandoffsPerHour.description: The most handoffs this machine sends in any hour.
